If it is Kodi (kodi.bin), a recently ins: If it is Kodi (kodi.bin), a recently installed add-on or skin is a common cause. Crashes during updates can point to a weak power supply or a failing SD card.

The power supply is too weak or its cabl: The power supply is too weak or its cable too thin. Use the official power supply, and power USB disks through a powered hub.
A USB device is not responding properly. Try another port or cable. USB disks may need more power (a powered hub).
The TV or receiver keeps dropping the HD: The TV or receiver keeps dropping the HDMI connection. Try another HDMI cable or input, and avoid switches or adapters in between.
